description: This file is an HTML document used to load and configure the CodeMirror text editor with the 'yaml-frontmatter' mode. It includes references to JavaScript scripts and CSS styles relevant for rendering an editor with YAML front matter syntax highlighting, along with embedded sample YAML content.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor from the specified textarea element with the mode set to 'yaml-frontmatter'.
